## Description

Tilts holdings toward predictive signals while constraining tracking error, active weights, sector/style exposure or turnover versus a benchmark.

## Where it may fit

Index-relative mandates where modest alpha is sought while keeping benchmark risk and active share controlled.

## Vehicles

Enhanced-index, institutional equity, ETF and pension mandates.

## Required data

Benchmark weights/returns, signal forecasts, covariance/risk model, point-in-time constituents, costs and constraints.

## Caveats

Benchmark weights must be point-in-time; the risk model can be wrong, and after-cost alpha must justify active risk and turnover.
